title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the joint communication on humanitarian aid (JOIN(2026)0025)
part_text: 4.Calls on the Council, the High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy and the Member States to refrain from introducing broad or automatic humanitarian exemptions and safeguards that could undermine the effectiveness of restrictive measures, and to ensure that any derogations are strictly necessary and proportionate and accompanied by robust oversight, transparency and anti-diversion safeguards that prevent the misuse of humanitarian and development assistance, including through corruption or their diversion to sanctioned entities;
